Support the CFO in diligence with the SPAC sponsor, PIPE investors, bankers, auditors, and legal counsel. Build public-company forecasting rigor: monthly and quarterly forecasts with variance analysis tight enough to support external guidance. Help establish investor relations processes: guidance framework, earnings preparation, consensus tracking and board/investor materials. Work with Accounting and Controllership to support SEC reporting, SOX readiness, and controls around forecasting and projections. Performance management and reporting Deliver monthly and quarterly business reviews, executive dashboards, and board reporting. Lead budget-vs-actual and forecast-vs-actual analysis with clear drivers and recommended actions. Own cash forecasting and runway planning Drive cost discipline, including headcount planning, vendor spend, and operating leverage. Strategic mindset: comfortable shaping decisions, not only reporting on them, and able to push back with data. Expert financial modeling skills: three-statement, driver-based, and scenario models built to withstand investor and auditor scrutiny. Strong executive presence and communication skills; able to present clearly to boards, investors, and non-finance leaders. AI-first culture: hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., LLM assistants, AI-enabled planning and BI platforms) to automate reporting, improve forecasting and analysis with sound judgment on accuracy, data security and controls Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related field. Background in investment banking, private equity, or corporate development.
